phase: P5 variance inflation for under-evidenced teams
status: IMPLEMENTED BUT OFF — the measurement says do not enable it
original_rationale: The P1 baseline showed thin favourites badly overconfident: 0.50-0.65 bucket predicted 0.541, observed 0.322 (error -0.221). The plan proposed widening intervals for under-evidenced clubs.

why_it_no_longer_applies.explanation: P3 gave 20 leagues real domestic data, P4b seeded clubs from their own league instead of a 25-league pooled mean, and the xg gating stopped flat components diluting informative ones. The miscalibration was under-MEASUREMENT, not missing variance. Inflating now would push well-calibrated predictions away from reality.

ab_walk_forward_2024_07_onward.verdict: inflation is WORSE on both metrics — leave OFF

kept_because: Coverage can degrade — a new unsourced league, a provider outage, a wave of newly promoted clubs. The mechanism and its A/B harness stay in place so the question can be re-answered with data rather than re-argued from theory.
